topic: Humanoid robots in real automotive manufacturing — BMW / Figure 02 and Figure 03 (2025–2026)
candidate_hook: These humanoid robots aren't demos anymore. One helped build 30,000 BMWs.

sources.name: BMW Group PressClub — Figure 03 project in Spartanburg
sources.notes: June 25 2026: Figure 03 demonstrated a new assembly/logistics use case; predecessor Figure 02 supported >30,000 X3.
